svg.title: Kiro Gateway on AWS: Kiro clients through an internal NLB to Squid and APISIX with the guard, a Bedrock guardrail check, egress through NAT to the Kiro endpoints, the portal behind CloudFront, AWS WAF and an internal ALB, with EBS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager and CloudWatch
